SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, 
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers)::float, 3) as yt_per_angler,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 200 AND fish_date_doy <= 213
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC

SELECT ts_doy, 
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_water_temp_c,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32), 1) as avg_water_temp_f,
  COUNT(*) as readings
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 190 AND ts_doy <= 213
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy
